protocol: Summerside q032001 shared station/wharf visual ownership native preregistration/1
before: Evidence locks the attached baseline from actual #238, no candidate code/test/frame was used to choose geometry or screen exceptions.
wharf: Exact same signed deck and seven measured shell model definitions (or off); no map change, no existing business identity, no new survey data.

stationStreetExisting.name: curb-close
stationStreetExisting.qualification: Pin exact stock-derived baseH/eyeY before enabling either new actor.

nearWharfPreCandidate.name: wharf-independent-close
nearWharfPreCandidate.qualification: Game-only sightline derived from the shipped deck anchor and existing Harbor station compass bearing, not a new photo fit. Do not move if it becomes obscured.

farDefault.qualification: force both requested, cold boot and flight; no wharf/station optional requests outside their gated scope. Native dispatch spinnakers-low can never be blocked by unresolved optional deck bytes.

signedSourceControls.storage: signed Uint32 original indices; no Uint16 overflow, no regenerating or splitting the six shared attributes. Preserve all legacy and regional/hard-coded authored owners. Any extra unsupported attribute, generated count or signed span mismatch fails closed to full stock.

nextStates: both→only wharf→both→only station→none→both in same tick/service; each complementary actor commits/restores atomically, never hide stock without resident authored replacement.
retain: Six buffers byte- and BufferAttribute-identical; same tile world transform/material/side and normal/index type. Independently read actual GPU live attribute and element uploads, keep monotonic triangles and exact sorted void. No unaffected AEB row, detached object, measured roof, same station context, field/tree/road or light changes. All four measured downtown roofs (3 on q032001, 1 q03200300), identical root omission and water/shade mode from #238.
matchedA_B.visual: Render exact same tick stock/both/separate without scene switches, then use authenticated all-primitive convex projected extents: zero exterior RGBA beyond union +2px for both; pairwise wharf toggling cannot change station-only pixels except proved overlap/occlusion. Keep no unrelated wet source changes. Reference screenshot is always a simulation, not contemporary waterfront accuracy.

nonidentities.basis: Cold broad register yields independent wholly negative cover samples and named source ranges, but wet classification does not tell whether a structure should stand on a true pier; no blanket deletion, flattening or shore edit.

faultsAndLifecycle: Genuine local only request: profile, signed source chunk/full tile/span and compatible unchanged cover before mounting; no blocking of stock decode, one bounded optional loader per immutable alive owner/cold demand; verify exact official pack and all seven shell build. Resolve failing art/seat independently. Missing/wrong-size/bitflip/malformed/late/evicted wharf states equal station-only RGBA; analogous station fault equals wharf-only; both faults equal none. Test still-readable but different q032001 bytes (no candidate owner) separately from entirely undecodable baseline.
coldBound: Distant fresh visit to Cavendish with wharf/station enabled must not transfer wharf/station optional module/asset. Legacy preflight only opt-in compatibility, not necessary on pass-through. Retain exact site motion/terrain/watch unchanged across zoom departure and late re-entry. Measure bounded frame expansions/caches but no FPS claim.
lifecycle: Single q032001 owner arbiter, no concurrent geometry writers; complete unindexed original canonical state, three lazy complement views at one owner lifetime. Never dispose shared BufferAttribute view independently while live; detach groups/shadow proxies then dispose at eviction. Exact active↔inactive mask switching only when necessary. On eviction, auth loss, controller death, guard failure or foreign geometry, actors withdraw without destroying/replacing another system’s current mesh. Asynchronous stages must capture original identity and generation/alive; no late reattach.
distinctShadowProfile: Ordinary Standard keeps original shadow system state. Old explicit station-with-buildingShadows assessment still renders as before; keep legacy north baywalk/Detail coupled to its preflight/cover and route, never auto-upgrade. If any new co-active shadow variant exists, users must see identical unaffected casters: neighbor caster uses exact currently allowed joint complement; station authored caster replaces precisely station when active; wharf adds no unverified caster. On geometry/index visibility change issue leaseOwnerChanged in same frame, prove exact shadow atlas bytes outside true projected caster footprint, cache invalidation and repeat draw stability, plus failed/fallback same. Never silently inherit old emitted shadow silhouette or zero unrelated shadows.
noGlobalPhysicsChange: Exact cover, shoreline water under all five original deck controls, stock upper/lower terrain/query and material diagnostics; no ground profile/model Y changes apart from existing isolated visual wharf art. Real compiled Dispatch/Begin/Cockpit/Wide chase/Pause positive and fault controls under both/none and distant.
watch: Do not use historical legacy paired frames as same-profile byte identity; they implicitly flipped narrow settings, sometimes changing the entire image. Device/sunset, AGL, preview and unknown switches require explicit fail-closed profile handling; do not advertise 1:1 city redevelopment or universal anti-alias counts.
